name: papertrail
description: Graph-RAG + Multi-Agent System for research synthesis

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && python -m black . && python -m isort .
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && python -m black . && python -m isort .
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt

author: PaperTrail Team
